name: dev.workers.asostudio.aso-x402-screen/edgescreen
title: EdgeScreen x402 Security Screening
description: Deterministic OFAC, SSRF, MCP, A2A, AI compliance, CSV preflight & EVM firewall over MCP and x402.

tools.name: screen_x402_challenge
tools.description: Check an x402 endpoint challenge before paying: detect spoofed stablecoins, decimal inflation, price mismatch, unsafe recipients, and SSRF URLs across Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon, and Solana. Returns findings, USD estimate, and Ed25519 receipt. $0.002 (2000 atomic) Base USDC.

inputSchema.description: A raw x402 challenge or {challenge, advertised_price_usd?, micro_call?, openapi?}. Also accepts {headers, body?}, payment_required or www_authenticate. Supplied content only; URLs are never fetched.

challenge.description: Raw x402 v1/v2 challenge JSON object or base64 PAYMENT-REQUIRED string.

body.description: Optional HTTP 402 response body object or text.

advertised_price_usd.description: Optional expected USD price for mismatch detection.

micro_call.description: Assert a micro-call ceiling of $1.00 USD.

openapi.description: Optional JSON OpenAPI operation or document; never fetched.

x402Version.description: Top-level x402 protocol version (1 or 2) when passing a raw challenge object.

accepts.description: Top-level x402 payment requirement offers array.

tools.name: verify_audit_receipt
tools.description: Verify an EdgeScreen Ed25519 signed audit receipt or PAYMENT-REFERRAL-RECEIPT for $0.00, without a wallet. Returns valid, receiptType, signerPublicKey, payloadSummary and verifiedAt using trusted server public keys. Unknown keys or tampering return valid=false; no payment or payout confirmation.

signedReceipt.description: Base64url signedReceipt from an audit or PAYMENT-REFERRAL-RECEIPT header.

Use screen_impersonation for the 61-brand DeFi/AI handle corpus.
